trello.name: Configure Stripe subscription products and prices
trello.desc: Create three subscription tiers in Stripe Dashboard and ensure they are correctly configured with pricing and metadata. Basic $29/month with basic AI model selection tool and limited feature set. Pro $49/month with additional features and priority support. Enterprise $99/month with all features, custom support, and integration options. Ensure product names, descriptions, and metadata align with app feature set for accurate billing and UI mapping. Owner: Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Products visible in Stripe, prices correct, test customers can be created for each tier.

trello.name: Update pricing page with tier comparison
trello.desc: Update the public pricing page to display Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with clear monthly pricing and feature comparison table. Design should be clean and straightforward, with prominent checkout button per tier. Include tooltip or help icon explaining what happens when users change plans later. Owner: Jordan. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Page reflects $29/$49/$99 pricing, feature comparison accurate, design matches app style.

trello.name: Implement Stripe Elements checkout flow
trello.desc: Build checkout UI using Stripe Elements, styled to match app design. Form must collect payment details securely and handle graceful error handling for invalid card details, insufficient funds, and other Stripe errors with user-friendly messages. Integrate with backend subscription creation endpoint. Owner: Jordan. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Checkout renders correctly, errors displayed clearly, successful payment triggers subscription creation.

trello.name: Build user dashboard subscription management UI
trello.desc: Create dashboard section showing current plan details and billing info, real-time subscription status, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, access to invoices and payment history, and ability to update payment methods. Display notifications for successful upgrades, payment failures, and other status changes. Owner: Jordan. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Dashboard reflects live Stripe data, actions trigger backend API calls, UI is intuitive.

trello.name: Implement backend Stripe API integration for subscriptions
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe API to create and manage subscriptions, process payments, and sync subscription state with internal user records. Implement endpoints for creating subscription on checkout, retrieving subscription status, updating payment method, and handling plan changes. Owner: Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: API endpoints functional, subscriptions created in Stripe and DB synced.

trello.name: Set up Stripe webhook handlers
trello.desc: Configure and implement webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Handlers must update user access rights, subscription status, and trigger notifications. Include idempotency and error logging. Owner: Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Webhooks receive events in test mode, system state updates correctly.

trello.name: Implement payment failure notifications
trello.desc: On invoice.payment_failed webhook, notify user via in-app notification and send email prompting them to update payment information. Provide clear instructions on how to fix payment. Owner: Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Email sent, dashboard shows alert, user can update card.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend subscription API for real-time updates
trello.desc: Connect dashboard and checkout components to backend API so subscription changes are reflected in real-time. Handle loading states and API errors with clear user notifications for subscription confirmations and payment errors. Coordinate with Taylor on API contracts. Owner: Jordan with Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: UI updates without manual refresh after webhook events.

trello.name: Create and execute test plan for subscription flow
trello.desc: Prepare detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing subscription. Include test scenarios for payment success, payment failure, cancellation, upgrade/downgrade, webhook delivery, and edge cases. Execute testing during week 3. Owner: Taylor lead, Jordan. Due: test plan in 2 weeks, execution week 3. Acceptance: Test plan documented and shared, all critical flows pass.

trello.name: Create user documentation and support FAQ
trello.desc: Plan and draft user-facing documentation and help section/FAQ covering how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, update payment methods, and handle common issues. Ensure docs are clear for post-launch support. Owner: Alex/Jordan. Due: after initial integration. Acceptance: Help section published with subscription topics.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook handlers
trello.desc: Document backend API endpoints, request/response schemas, and webhook event handlers for Stripe integration to ease maintenance and troubleshooting. Include setup instructions for local testing. Owner: Taylor. Due: within 2 weeks. Acceptance: Documentation complete and shared with team.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up progress meeting
trello.desc: Schedule next follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on Stripe integration, address blockers, and confirm alignment between frontend and backend. Owner: Alex. Due: 1 week. Acceptance: Meeting scheduled with agenda sent.
